Name: Prismatic Crafting
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[heading][size=4][b]Craftable Prismatic Shard[/b][/size][/heading]
Adds a crafting recipe for the Prismatic Shard. 

The recipe is intentionally expensive.

[b][b]This was designed to be used along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url].[/b][/b]

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
